newsitem.title: UK: BAT says interest in India, ITC unshaken.
newsitem.headline: BAT says interest in India, ITC unshaken.

text.p: British tobacco and financial services group B.A.T Industries Plc repeated on Wednesday that its fundamental attitude to India and its associate company ITC Ltd remains positive and one of continued commitment.

A series of arrests of former ITC executives, as well as one current manager, and the continued questioning of ITC personnel on allegations of breaches of India's foreign exchange rules has shaken ITC's share price since last week.
B.A.T, which is the single biggest shareholder in ITC with 31.7 percent, has pledged to work with the company's other Indian institutional shareholders to monitor the situation.
"This is a very valuable investment...there is no change to our investment view of ITC," a B.A.T spokesman said.
"We feel that India is a market with huge potential both in tobacco and financial services and we look forward to working with our associates on this," he added.
